incident: The standalone MU shadow observer exited after its last successful 2026-08-17T16:42:49.778Z poll and before the frozen 16:45Z decision could be recorded. The finalizer remained alive but cannot create observer decisions. A bounded restart at 16:53:03.578Z correctly censored the 16:45Z bar as retroactive and advanced the durable cursor without publishing a decision.

causal_evidence.interpretation: Stable observer prefix ends at decision_time_ms 1786984200000 and contains no row for 1786985100000.
The 16:30-16:45Z source candle was first captured at 16:53:03.578Z with prospective=false, proving the missed decision cannot be relabeled prospective.
The durable cursor advanced to the censored 16:45Z boundary, preventing duplicate or retroactive reconstruction.
The preregistration requires all 96 decisions, forbids replacement-window selection, and declares any missing observer decision a technical failure.

decision: Do not reconstruct the missing decision, shrink the window, select a replacement interval, or modify frozen generator bytes before the immutable finalizer publishes. Continue the unchanged observer for the remaining boundaries so the final report attributes an isolated outage rather than conflating it with later missing data. After publication, introduce a new observer generation with durable failure telemetry and bounded retry for explicitly classified transient public-data failures, then preregister a new window only as new evidence rather than a replacement for this failure.
validation_completed: Verified the old observer process and child were absent before restart.
Validated every frozen generator hash before the bounded restart.
Reclaimed the dead singleton lock without overlap.
Observed a report-only bounded poll with no signer, orders, or intents.
Confirmed the late candle is prospective=false and the required decision journal row is absent.
Restarted the unchanged report-only observer for remaining causal boundaries.
validation_still_required: The immutable post-cutoff finalizer must publish FAIL with missing_observer_decisions and exact 16:45Z attribution.
Remaining predeclared decision boundaries must be observed without another gap.
A post-window TDD repair must make transient source failure and observer exit durable without converting stale data into prospective evidence.
A new future window must be preregistered only after the repaired observer survives restart and fault-injection tests.
falsifier: Update this incident only if an immutable exact observer row for decision_time_ms 1786985100000 is found in the preregistered journal prefix with a receipt-causal observation at or before its freshness boundary, or if the finalizer proves the timestamp was not part of the frozen 96-decision scope. Neither condition is currently present.
